mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, conditions are 50 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park. Looking ahead, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 46 degrees, and we are expecting a dry night with no rain in the forecast.

The Public Works Department reminds residents that they handle maintenance for our streets and utilities, and you can keep up with their latest updates by subscribing to the city newsletter. Additionally, the city has updated its requirements for erosion control and stormwater management permits for any upcoming construction projects.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to more fun with trivia at The Bogey Factory, ART House 360 events, or Hop Haus trivia.
In a report from October 25, officers handled a situation at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a man passed out behind the wheel, which resulted in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 55 minutes, so be sure to get there quickly if you want a treat tonight.
